settings.heading:
Detroit,
On Your Back.
settings.body: Heavyweight cotton cut for people who actually move. Made in small runs, finished by hand, and named for the streets it came from.

settings.label: The cloth
settings.body: Heavyweight cotton, garment-dyed, washed before it is cut.

settings.label: Dispatch
settings.body: Orders leave Metro Detroit inside two days.

settings.label: Styles in the run
settings.body: Restocked rather than replaced when they sell out.

settings.label: To change your mind
settings.body: Unworn, tags on, shipping covered both ways.

settings.heading: Straight off the line.
settings.body: Every card carries the same information in the same place: name, price, the colourways that actually exist.

settings.heading: Washed twice, so it never shrinks on you.
settings.body: Garment-dyed then washed again before it is cut. What you pull out of the dryer in month six is the same tee you opened in week one.
